program: Runs the binference engine and talks to it from the terminal.
option.json: Print JSON for scripts instead of text
option.set: Set a config key for this run, written as `key=value`
option.lines: How many of the last lines to show
option.follow: Keep showing new lines until you press Ctrl+C
option.agent: The agent's id; the only agent when left out
option.wallet: The wallet's id; the agent's default wallet when left out
option.agentOrAll: The agent's id; every agent and the install when left out
option.label: A name for the address, such as cold wallet
option.walletLabel: A name for the wallet, such as savings
option.fix: Fix what the check may fix: make files and folders others can open yours alone
command.start: Start the engine in this terminal; Ctrl+C stops it
command.status: Show whether the engine runs, its agents and its health signals
command.health: Check that the engine runs and is ready
command.approval: Show the agent's approval mode, or set it to manual or auto
argument.mode: The approval mode to set: manual or auto
command.live: Switch the agent to live: its trades use real money from its wallet
command.paper: Switch the agent back to paper mode, where nothing is sent on chain
command.confirm: Confirm the card of an intent, as its Confirm button does
command.deny: Cancel the card of an intent, as its Cancel button does
argument.intent: The intent's id, starting with int_
command.wallet: List the agent wallets and show the address to fund
command.walletList: List the agent wallets, each with its label and address
command.walletAddress: Show the address to fund the agent's default wallet at
command.walletCreate: Make a new agent wallet under a ceiling of its own; asks for the owner key
command.freeze: Freeze every agent and the install, or the agent --agent names: their open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled
command.unfreeze: Open the card that unfreezes every frozen agent, or the agent --agent names; confirming it unfreezes
command.safety: Show what is frozen, the rescue under way and the rescue address
command.safetyStatus: Show what is frozen, the rescue under way and the rescue address
command.address: List, save and remove the addresses a send may pay
command.addressList: List the agent's saved addresses, each with when a send may pay it
command.addressAdd: Save an address a send may pay, in the address book and the wallets' ceilings; asks for the owner key
command.addressRemove: Remove a saved address: binference sends nothing to it from then on
argument.sendAddress: The address on BNB Chain, starting with 0x
argument.entry: The address book entry's id, starting with adr_
command.check: Check this install: its config, who can open its files, its unlock mode and the engine
usage.invalid: binference cannot read this command line. Run `binference --help` to see the commands and what each one takes.
start.ready: binference is running. The console and the WebSocket are at http://{host}:{port}, the local IPC at {ipc}, and the log at {logFile}. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
start.missingParts: This binference serves the protocol but cannot trade yet: prices and wallet facts are not built in, so it refuses every trade.
start.stoppedLate: binference stopped, but these steps did not finish: {steps}. Run `binference logs` to see why.
start.alreadyRunning: binference already runs on the state folder {folder}. Stop it first, or set BINFERENCE_HOME to another folder.
start.configInvalid: {file} has {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}. Fix each one, then start again.
start.storeDamaged: The database {file} failed its integrity check. Restore a backup, then start again.
start.portTaken: Port {port} is in use by another program. Stop that program, or set `engine.port` in config.json5 to a free port.
config.unreadable: {file} is not valid JSON5 at line {line}, column {column}.
config.newer_version: {file} is version {version}, from a newer binference; this one reads up to version {supported}.
config.older_version: {file} is version {version}; this binference reads version {current}.
config.bad_value: {path} holds a value it does not take (got {got}).
config.bad_value_unseen: {path} holds a value it does not take.
config.bad_key: {path} uses a name that is not valid at that place.
config.secret_inline: {path} holds a secret as plain text.
config.bad_flag: The flag {flag} is not written as `--set key=value`.
configFix.update_binference: Update binference, or restore a backup of {file}.
configFix.remove_key.file: Remove it from {file}, or check its spelling.
configFix.remove_key.flag: Leave out the flag {flag}, or check its spelling.
configFix.change_value.file: Set it in {file} or remove it.
configFix.change_value.env: Set {variable} to a value it takes, or unset it.
configFix.change_value.flag: Change the flag {flag}, or leave it out.
configFix.use_secret_source: Run `binference check --fix` to move it to the keychain, or write a secret source in its place.
connect.notRunning: binference is not running on the state folder {folder}. Start it with `binference start`.
connect.noSignIn: The CLI cannot sign in: {file} is missing. Start binference once with `binference start` to write it.
connect.refused: binference refused the CLI ({code}). Start binference again with `binference start`, so the CLI can sign in again.
connect.failed: binference did not answer ({code}). Run `binference logs` to see why.
status.summary: binference {version} is {state, select, ready {running} starting {starting} locked {running but locked} other {{state}}}, on protocol version {protocol}.
status.agents: {count, plural, =0 {No agents yet.} one {# agent:} other {# agents:}}
status.agent: {id}: {mode, select, paper {paper mode} live {live} other {{mode}}}{frozen, select, yes {, frozen} other {}}
status.signal: {name}: {state, select, ok {ok} warn {needs a look} fail {failing} other {{state}}}
health.starting: binference is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
logs.none: There is no log yet at {file}. Start binference with `binference start`.
agent.none: binference has no agent yet. Run `binference init` to make one.
agent.several: binference has {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}. Name one with `--agent`: {agents}.
approval.current: {agent} is in {mode, select, auto {auto} other {manual}} mode, since {changedAt}.
approval.unchanged: {agent} is in {mode, select, auto {auto} other {manual}} mode already, since {changedAt}.
approval.set: {agent} is in {mode, select, auto {auto} other {manual}} mode now, since {changedAt}.
approval.autoNote: In auto mode, the agent's buys, sells and swaps within its per-trade cap and its 24-hour cap run without a tap, each with a receipt. Sends and anything over a cap still ask you. Run `binference approval manual` to switch back.
mode.live: {name} ({agent}) is live now. Its trades use real money from its wallet, and its first live card says so.
mode.paper: {name} ({agent}) is in paper mode now: its trades fill on paper and nothing is sent on chain. Cards already open keep the mode they were proposed in.
mode.fundFirst: Run `binference wallet address` to see the address to fund.
confirm.paperWaiting: Confirmed {intent}. It fills on paper once binference has a price for what it sells.
confirm.sending: Confirmed {intent}. binference is sending it on chain.
confirm.reopened: The price moved, so binference opened card version {version}: {sold} → at least {bought}. Check it, then run `binference confirm {intent}` again.
confirm.unfrozen: Confirmed {intent}. {scope, select, install {Every agent is unfrozen} other {{agent} is unfrozen}}.
wallet.count: {count, plural, =0 {No agent wallets yet.} one {# agent wallet:} other {# agent wallets:}}
wallet.item: {label} ({wallet}) of {agent}: {address} on {chain}{archived, select, yes {, archived} other {}}
wallet.address: To fund {label} ({wallet}), pay into this address on {chain}:
wallet.none: {agent} has no wallet yet. Run `binference init` to make one.
wallet.created: Made {label} ({wallet}) for {agent} on {chain}. Its ceiling lets it trade on the agent's venues and send only to the rescue address and the saved addresses. To fund it, pay into this address:
check.summary: {checks, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}} ran: {problems, plural, =0 {no problem} one {# problem} other {# problems}} and {warnings, plural, =0 {no warning} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}.
check.open: Other accounts on this machine can open {path}. Run `binference check --fix` to make it yours alone.
check.unchecked: This system does not tell binference who can open {count, plural, one {# file or folder} other {# files and folders}} of the state folder. Run `binference check --fix` to make them yours alone.
check.configInvalid: {file} has {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}:
check.unlockFile: The agent key and the Privy app secret are in files in {folder} (unlock mode `file`): a copy of this disk lets someone sign inside the ceiling until you remove the agent key. Set `engine.unlock.mode` to `keychain` or `command` where you can.
error.homeNotAbsolute: BINFERENCE_HOME is not an absolute path. Set it to a full path, or unset it to use the state folder in your home folder.
error.pathTooLong: The state folder's path is too long for a local socket. Set BINFERENCE_HOME to a shorter folder.
error.unexpected: binference stopped on an error ({code}). Run `binference logs` to see what happened.
option.privyAppSecret: The Privy app secret's source, written as in config.json5
option.botToken: The bot token's source, written as in config.json5
option.rescue: Your rescue address on BNB Chain
option.unlock: Where this machine keeps the agent key: `keychain`, `file`, `manual` or `command`
option.unlockCommand: With --unlock command: the program that prints the agent key, written as in config.json5
option.setInit: Set a config key in the file init writes, written as `key=value`
option.startOver: Set up a folder set up before again, with a new owner key and a new wallet
command.init: Set up binference: your Privy app, your owner key, your first wallet and your bot
status.locked: Locked: binference signs nothing until you run `binference unlock` on this machine.
health.locked: binference is running but locked: it signs nothing until you run `binference unlock` on this machine.
start.locked: binference is locked and signs nothing: {reason, select, needs_passphrase {it needs the passphrase of the agent key} wrong_passphrase {the passphrase does not open the agent key} agent_key_missing {no agent key is where the unlock mode reads it; put back the copy you keep} agent_key_invalid {the agent key there is not the one your wallets name as their signer; put the right one back} keychain_failed {the OS keychain did not respond; unlock it and try again} command_failed {the unlock command printed no agent key; run it yourself to see why} app_secret_missing {config.json5 names no Privy app secret; set `custody.privy.appSecret`} app_secret_unavailable {the Privy app secret is not where `custody.privy.appSecret` names it} app_secret_rejected {Privy refused the app ID and app secret; check `custody.privy` in config.json5} custody_unreachable {Privy did not respond; check this machine's network} signer_failed {the signer did not start or does not hold the key your wallets name; `binference logs` shows why} other {{reason}}}. Run `binference unlock` to open the agent key.
command.unlock: Open the agent key so binference can sign; asks for the passphrase in the manual unlock mode
unlock.ask: Passphrase of this machine's agent key (hidden)
unlock.wrong: That passphrase does not open the agent key. Try again.
unlock.needsTerminal: The manual unlock mode asks for the passphrase. Run `binference unlock` in a terminal, without --yes or --json.
unlock.failed: binference stays locked: {reason, select, needs_passphrase {it needs the passphrase of the agent key} wrong_passphrase {the passphrase does not open the agent key} agent_key_missing {no agent key is where the unlock mode reads it; put back the copy you keep} agent_key_invalid {the agent key there is not the one your wallets name as their signer; put the right one back} keychain_failed {the OS keychain did not respond; unlock it and try again} command_failed {the unlock command printed no agent key; run it yourself to see why} app_secret_missing {config.json5 names no Privy app secret; set `custody.privy.appSecret`} app_secret_unavailable {the Privy app secret is not where `custody.privy.appSecret` names it} app_secret_rejected {Privy refused the app ID and app secret; check `custody.privy` in config.json5} custody_unreachable {Privy did not respond; check this machine's network} signer_failed {the signer did not start or does not hold the key your wallets name; `binference logs` shows why} other {{reason}}}.
command.rescue: Open the rescue card: it moves everything in every agent wallet to your rescue address
command.rescueSet: Make an address the rescue address in 24 hours; asks for the owner key
argument.address: Your own wallet's address on BNB Chain, starting with 0x
ownerKey.wrong: That is not the owner key of this install. Try again.
ownerKey.wrongEnd: That is not the owner key of this install. Nothing changed.
ownerKey.needsTerminal: This asks for the owner key. Run `binference {command}` in a terminal, without --yes or --json.
rescue.badAddress: {address} is no address on BNB Chain. Give an address that starts with 0x and has 40 more characters.
rescue.set: The rescue address becomes {address} at {when}. Every surface announces it, and you can cancel it until then.
rescue.opened: binference opened the rescue card {intent}. It moves everything every agent wallet holds, except each wallet's gas reserve, to {address}, in paper mode too. Confirm it with `binference confirm {intent}`, or tap Confirm on Telegram or in the console.
freeze.all: Every agent is frozen since {when}, and every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen. Their open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled; a transaction already sent finishes.
freeze.agent: {agent} is frozen since {when}. Its open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled; a transaction already sent finishes.
freeze.undo: To unfreeze, run `binference unfreeze` and confirm the card it opens.
unfreeze.opened: binference opened the unfreeze card {intent}. Confirm it with `binference confirm {intent}`, or tap Confirm on Telegram or in the console.
unfreeze.nothing: Nothing is frozen, so there is nothing to unfreeze.
safety.installFrozen: The whole install is frozen since {when}: every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen.
safety.frozenAgents: {count, plural, =0 {No agent is frozen.} one {# frozen agent:} other {# frozen agents:}}
safety.rescue: A rescue is under way: {intent}, {state, select, awaiting_confirmation {waiting for your confirmation} confirmed {confirmed} executing {sending} included {sent, waiting to be final} finalized {final, being recorded} other {{state}}}.
safety.noRescueAddress: No rescue address is set. Run `binference rescue set` with your own wallet's address.
address.badAddress: {address} is no address on BNB Chain. Give an address that starts with 0x and has 40 more characters.
address.added: Saved {address} on {chain} as {label} for {agent} ({entry}). Its wallets' ceilings let a send pay it now; at send level 2 a send may pay it from {usableAt}.
address.already: {address} on {chain} is saved already for {agent}, as {label} ({entry}), since {createdAt}.
address.count: {count, plural, =0 {{agent} has no saved address.} one {{agent} has # saved address:} other {{agent} has # saved addresses:}}
address.item: {label} ({entry}): {address} on {chain}, usable at send level 2 from {usableAt}{saved, select, no {, not in the ceilings} other {}}
address.removed: Removed {entry} from the address book: binference sends nothing to it from now on.
